definitions.explanation: Describes something that applies broadly or comprehensively rather than to specific parts. Often used when summarizing or giving an overall assessment.

examples.japanese: {全般的|ぜんぱんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧だった。
{全般的|ぜんぱんてき}な⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、{売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{伸|の}びている→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧。
examples.english: As a general trend, sales are growing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{全般的|ぜんぱんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{難易度|なんいど}→難易度：27522_nanido⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}かった→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}います→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think this test was difficult across the board.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a na-adjective modifier ({全般的|ぜんぱんてき}な + noun) or as an adverb ({全般的|ぜんぱんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧). The adverbial form {全般的|ぜんぱんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is particularly common in writing and formal speech to introduce overall assessments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全般的|ぜんぱんてき}な⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧ (overall evaluation)
- {全般的|ぜんぱんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧ (looking at it overall)
- {全般的|ぜんぱんてき}な⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧ (general trend)

SIMILAR WORDS:
Compare with ⟦{全体的|ぜんたいてき}→全体的：11663_zentaiteki⟧ (as a whole), which emphasizes the whole as a single unit, while {全般的|ぜんぱんてき} emphasizes breadth across various aspects or areas.
